diagnostic_evidence.quote: In fact, \Cref{prop_Labs_equ} ensures that the summands in \eqref{eq_Rnj_indc} coincide for any two equivalent LN-trees $\Upsilon$.

issues.failure_explanation: The definition of $S$ uses exact equality of child subtrees in $N_P$, while equivalence allows children to be equivalent but not identical. For example, let $B=[[\;]_0 [\;]_1]_0$ and $C=[[\;]_1 [\;]_0]_0$. Then $B\sim C$ but $B\neq C$. The trees $\Upsilon=(B C)_0$ and $\Upsilon'=(B B)_0$ are equivalent, but $S(\Upsilon)=1$ while $S(\Upsilon')=2$. Thus $S$ is not preserved under equivalence, contradicting Proposition \ref{prop_Labs_equ}(ii). Consequently $S$ is not well-defined on ULN-trees, and the grouping step in the proof of Theorem \ref{thm_taylor} is invalid.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: No complete source-supported repair identified; at minimum, redefine the symmetry order so that it is invariant under equivalence (e.g., replace exact equality with equivalence in $N_P$) and re-establish the grouping and error expansion.
issues.overall_effect: The error expansion Theorem \ref{thm_taylor} and the order conditions derived from it are not rigorously established. The central Butcher theory for BSDEs is flawed, affecting the consistency and convergence claims.
issues.title: Symmetry order S is not invariant under LN-tree equivalence
issues.why_classification: The defect invalidates a central definition and a main theorem; repairing it requires reworking the symmetry factors and the expansion proof, with potential changes to the theoretical framework.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: Any $[\;]_k \in \T^1$ is defined to have no branches.

issues.failure_explanation: The tree $[\;]_0$ belongs to $\T_1$ and, according to Definition \ref{def_branch_ntree}, has no branches. Therefore the condition '$[\;]_0$ is not a branch of $\Upsilon$' holds for $\Upsilon=[\;]_0$, so $[\;]_0$ should be in $\T_{1-}$. However, the paper lists $\T_{1-}=\emptyset$ and the subsequent counts omit $[\;]_0$. This makes the definition inconsistent with its use.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Add the condition $\Upsilon \neq [\;]_0$ to the definition of $\T_{r-}$, or define $\T_{r-}$ directly as the listed sets.
issues.overall_effect: Minor: the definition of $\T_{r-}$ is off by the element $[\;]_0$. The order conditions are unaffected because $A_0^m([\;]_0)=0$ is already included in the first part of $C(r)$.
issues.title: Definition of T_{r-} is inconsistent with its listed sets
issues.why_classification: The repair is a one-line clarification and does not affect any substantive mathematical claim.
